title: Amazon earnings: AWS's growth rate 'no doubt' justifies the big AI spending
summary: Amazon (AMZN) reported second quarter earnings results that beat Wall Street's expectations. CFRA Research senior vice president of equity research, Arun Sundaram, chats with Yahoo Finance about his expectations for AWS.

title: Amazon Q2 earnings results beat Wall Street's estimates, as AWS continues to boom
summary: Amazon (AMZN) reported second quarter results on Thursday after the closing bell, with revenue coming in at $200.60 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $197.01 billion). Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré takes a closer look at the breaking numbers.

title: Amazon beats expectations with cloud and AI growth
summary: Amazon beat analysts' expectations on Thursday when it reported growth in overall revenue and sales, particularly in its cloud, artificial intelligence and chips divisions. The company meanwhile said that two of its AI-related divisions grew by "triple-digit percentages" -- its AI cloud and chips businesses each "exceeded" $25 billion annual revenue run rates, a measure of recurring sales.

title: Dow Jones Futures: Apple, Amazon Diverge Late; What To Do After AI Stocks Surge
summary: The stock market jumped Thursday as Microsoft powered a big AI rebound. Apple and Amazon led earnings late.

title: Amazon Gains in Postmarket After Earnings Report
summary: Amazon 2Q earnings beat Wall Street estimates Tuesday, sending stocks climbing in after hours trading. The company reporter its 5th straight quarter of cloud share growth, the 37% increase being the fastest for Amazon since the end of 2021. Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Analyst for E-Commerce Poonam Goyal, and Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Technology Analyst Anurag Rana break down the earnings numbers as they roll in.

title: Amazon's AWS Result Is 'Remarkable,' Analyst Luria Says
